evidence.note: ontologyDirtyAtom returns false on None, so dirty implies sessionOpen; dirty-without-session is never constructed.
documentBadge exclusive-reads !sessionOpen as No document, else dirty? Dirty: Saved, with no combined-true arm.

notes: Document badge none|saved|dirty. Leftover cluster on the documentToolbarState input after the busy-flag seed.

disqualifier.note: Shared ShaclValidationResult completeness vs conformance. This writer never emits truncated-and-conforming, but that is a producer subset: ClaimGate toVerdict ANDs the flags, and the public SHACL service supports all four combinations.

Leftover ReviewDialog locals after the reasonMissing/reasonTooLong seed. supersession is Option presence; reasonInvalid ORs the skipped length gates; confirmDisabled ORs that with review waiting. Combined-true is legal (invalid reason during an in-flight supersession).

injected is the stored negation of queryHasLimit inside injectLimit, not a second domain axis. Leftover after the startsWithAt/queryHasLimit seed; RunOntologySparqlResult already triaged limitInjected/truncated.
Leftover boolean-atom pair after inferred-view pairings. Dirty is a derived changelog-vs-saved projection; auto-open is a one-shot first-run latch. Writers never pair them; mixed pairs are ordinary.
Independent SHACL result badges. conforms picks the verdict chip; truncated optionally adds a second chip. Combined-true would render both; the reader never exclusive-matches the pair.

Leftover OntologyDocumentRegion pair after the dirty/inferred/undo/redo seed. inferredView is a keep-alive atom; sessionOpen disables the switch without clearing it, so inferred-true with no session is legal.
